turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail: 1️⃣ Sign up (this activates the weekly subscription) 2️⃣ Select a date for your first order 3️⃣ Make selections (you can preview via On the Menu, but to save you must sign up/log in) If you’re logged in: - Shop → pick items - My Menu → Change your meals - Adjust quantities with -/, add extras via Shop add-ons - You’ll be charged on the cut-off date; delivery arrives on your selected day App: - My Menu → Change your meals → Add to box → Update Selection - Continue to market → review cart/checkout
